rationale: Both Shan and Yasser work on autonomous vehicles from complementary angles—Shan leads embodied AI robotics at Ruyi Dynamics with a focus on hardware-software integration and real-world deployment, while Yasser is an ML engineer and researcher at Zoox building the perception and learning systems that power autonomous vehicles. Their overlapping domain expertise in autonomous-vehicles and computer vision could spark useful technical conversations about the intersection of AI research and production robotics.
intro_message: Shan, meet Yasser — you're both deep in autonomous vehicles (Shan on the embodied AI and robotics side at Ruyi Dynamics, Yasser on ML research at Zoox), and could have a great conversation about bridging AI research and real-world deployment.
